args.title: Returns Logistics Summary (Blog + Companion Piece)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a significant cost center for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs have cut handling costs by roughly 20% (one-fifth), showing centralization pays off operationally.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of their original margin, underscoring the value of speed in the resale/liquidation pipeline.
